about: The thyroid gland as an anatomy textbook draws it: two lobes joined by an isthmus, colloid-filled follicles, the calcitonin-making C cells, the capsule, the arterial supply and venous drainage, and the four parathyroid glands on the back. Follicles and C cells are drawn as representative beads, not counted. Activity is a display index driven by the engine's thyroid-hormone signal; it is not a hormone secretion rate. Calcium handling, parathyroid hormone and calcitonin are not simulated, so the C cells and parathyroids have no live drive.

GH14.label: Hall JE, Hall ME. Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. Elsevier, 2021.

GRAYS42.label: Standring S (ed). Gray's Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice, 42nd ed. Elsevier, 2020.

parts.label: Right Lobe
parts.summary: Larger lobe, beside the trachea and larynx
parts.function: Each lobe lies against the side of the trachea and the lower larynx, and holds the follicles that make thyroid hormone. The right lobe is usually the larger. Thyroid hormone sets the metabolic rate of nearly every tissue. It brightens when the simulated thyroid signal rises.

drives.note: The lobe is the source of thyroid hormone.

parts.label: Left Lobe
parts.summary: Left lobe, mirror of the right
parts.function: The left lobe has the same structure as the right and makes the same hormones. Together the lobes form the gland that sits in front of the trachea below the larynx. It brightens when the simulated thyroid signal rises.

drives.note: The lobe is the source of thyroid hormone.

parts.label: Isthmus
parts.summary: Bridge of tissue across the front of the trachea
parts.function: A narrow band of thyroid tissue joins the two lobes in front of the trachea, a little below the cricoid cartilage. It is made of the same follicular tissue as the lobes.

drives.note: It is follicular tissue making thyroid hormone.

parts.label: Follicles and Colloid
parts.summary: Colloid-filled spheres that store thyroid hormone
parts.function: Each follicle is a ring of epithelial cells around a store of colloid, which holds thyroglobulin carrying thyroid hormone ready for release. Pituitary TSH makes the cells take up iodide and release hormone into the blood. Here they are drawn as representative beads; they brighten with the simulated thyroid signal.

drives.note: Follicular cells make and release thyroid hormone.

parts.label: Parafollicular C Cells
parts.summary: Sparse cells between follicles; make calcitonin
parts.function: Scattered between the follicles are the parafollicular cells, which secrete calcitonin, a hormone that tends to lower plasma calcium. They are a separate cell line from the follicular cells. The simulator has no calcium signal, so they do not change.

parts.label: Capsule
parts.summary: Thin fibrous covering of the gland
parts.function: A thin fibrous capsule covers the gland and sends septa inwards that divide it into lobules. The gland is held close to the trachea by the pretracheal fascia around it. It is drawn as glass so the contents show through.

parts.label: Superior and Inferior Thyroid Arteries
parts.summary: Arterial supply from above and from below
parts.function: The superior thyroid artery comes from the external carotid and reaches the upper pole of each lobe. The inferior thyroid artery comes from the thyrocervical trunk and reaches the lower back of the lobe. The gland is among the most richly supplied organs for its size. Their glow follows cardiac output.

drives.note: Arterial inflow follows the output of the heart.
A falling output means less inflow.

parts.label: Thyroid Veins
parts.summary: Superior, middle and inferior veins carry hormone out
parts.function: The superior and middle thyroid veins drain to the internal jugular vein and the inferior thyroid veins to the brachiocephalic veins. Thyroid hormone leaves the gland in this venous blood. In the interior view an amber stream of hormone runs along them faster when the thyroid signal is high.

drives.note: Hormone leaves the gland in these veins.

parts.label: Parathyroid Glands
parts.summary: Four small glands on the back of the lobes
parts.function: Four small glands, two on each side, lie on the back of the thyroid lobes, and they are separate organs from the thyroid. They make parathyroid hormone, which raises plasma calcium. The simulator does not model calcium, so they do not change.

parts.label: Pyramidal Lobe
parts.summary: A narrow, variable finger of thyroid tissue rising from the isthmus
parts.function: It is not present in everyone. When present it rises from the isthmus or a lobe towards the hyoid bone, and is the same kind of tissue as the rest of the gland.

drives.note: It is follicular tissue making thyroid hormone, like the lobes.

parts.label: Follicular Cells
parts.summary: The cells that form the wall of each follicle (enlarged schematic)
parts.function: They take up iodine, build thyroid hormone on the protein in the colloid, and release it into the blood. Follicles are microscopic; three are drawn enlarged per lobe.

drives.note: These cells make and release thyroid hormone.

parts.label: Colloid (Thyroglobulin)
parts.summary: The store in the middle of each follicle (enlarged schematic)
parts.function: A gel rich in thyroglobulin, the protein on which thyroid hormone is built. It holds a store of hormone until the follicular cells take it back in and release it.

parts.label: Follicle Basement Membrane
parts.summary: The thin supporting sheet round each follicle (enlarged schematic)
parts.function: A thin layer outside the follicular cells that supports them and separates them from the capillaries around the follicle.

parts.label: Follicle Capillaries
parts.summary: Fine blood vessels wrapped round the follicles (schematic)
parts.function: Capillaries run between and around follicles, bringing in what the cells need and carrying hormone away into the blood.

drives.note: Blood flow through the gland follows the output of the heart.
A falling output means less flow.

parts.label: Superior Parathyroid Glands
parts.summary: The upper pair of parathyroid glands
parts.function: Two small glands on the back of the thyroid, higher up. Together with the lower pair they make parathyroid hormone, which raises blood calcium.

parts.label: Inferior Parathyroid Glands
parts.summary: The lower pair of parathyroid glands
parts.function: Two small glands on the back of the thyroid, lower down. Their position varies more than that of the upper pair.

parts.label: Chief Cells
parts.summary: The main hormone-making cells of the parathyroid (schematic)
parts.function: They make parathyroid hormone. Drawn as beads far larger than real cells.

parts.label: Oxyphil Cells
parts.summary: Larger, paler cells of the parathyroid (schematic)
parts.function: Larger cells scattered among the chief cells; their role is not settled. Drawn as beads far larger than real cells.
